target_customer: YC lists EV charging site developers; Aug 2020 press describes mobile professionals and sales teams using business apps in a keyboard
problem: Conflicting sources. YC says it finds profitable sites for EV charging stations; a 2020 article says it integrates business apps such as scheduling into mobile keyboards to work without a desktop.
business_model: Unknown; the keyboard product planned an app-store style marketplace of keyboard modules
product_category: Mobile keyboard business apps (2020 press); EV charging site analytics (YC listing)

founders.name: Christophe Barre
previous_startups: DeepLook (sales automation startup, outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Aug 2020 article says he is from the outskirts of Paris and worked in Latin America running business through WhatsApp.

founders.name: Ulysse Prygiel
founders.background_notes: The article names him (spelled Ulysses Pryjiel) as Barre's DeepLook co-founder and high school friend who worked on the idea.

technical_complexity.rationale: A keyboard extension embedding third-party apps on iOS and Android has platform constraints and security expectations, though the first app was a Calendly-style scheduler.

defensibility.rationale: No data or network effects documented; keyboard modules were copyable and depended on mobile OS rules.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The 2020 article named no direct competitor and cited SwiftKey only as a precedent for keyboard marketplaces; no source records an incumbent move.

market_need_then: The founder said messaging on WhatsApp lacked business features like scheduling. No spend or user numbers were found.

branding.domain_note: YC links getonekey.io; no acquisition history found.

brand_strength.rationale: Only one press piece and directory entries found; the name is shared with other products such as a hardware wallet brand.

outcome_analysis: OneKey is inactive on YC's list, but no source gives a shutdown date or cause, so the cause is not public. The two founders had a prior startup, DeepLook, and Barre later founded Tandem in 2024 at the Hexa studio, which suggests the team moved on. The YC description (EV charging) conflicts with 2020 press (keyboard apps) and no source explains the discrepancy.
notes: Funding search found nothing for OneKey; the article of 4 Aug 2020 mentions only the YC affiliation. The EV charging site-selection competitor search returned only companies founded later or undated pages (for example Mobilyze.ai, MyTraffic, undated), so the list is empty; the keyboard version named no rival. No company website was available; the YC page links getonekey.io but it was not fetched because the YC page gave no usable link text. Roundfunded page is a reconstruction and was not used.
